steps.instruction: Sit upright, then press CONFIRM POSITION.
steps.hint: CONFIRM POSITION is the button on the desk in front of you. Calibration records your seated position so every control stays within reach.

steps.instruction: Press PAUSE to open the pause menu.
steps.hint: PAUSE is the button on the right of the desk; the MENU button or ESC key also opens it. Pausing stops the attempt timer.

steps.instruction: Press RECENTER in the pause menu.
steps.hint: RECENTER is the second button in the pause menu. Recentering turns your view back to face the training desk.
RESUME is the top button in the pause menu. The attempt timer continues from where it stopped when you resume.
